name: Tanetsuke Mura ~Hakudakugami, Nenbutsu Kou no Gi~
original_name: 種憑け村～白濁神、念仏講ノ儀～
source:
This is the story of one village - about which few people know ... about their strange rituals ...
One day a group of people gathers for ethnographic research in this village, to reveal secrets and adopt their folklore...

But the roots of this village and everything that happens in it go very deep ...
In the village, the women saw what was happening there and were shocked.
Will they go crazy or.....
